question: By whom was the teaching concerning the earth-moving yoginīs communicated?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-moving yoginīs
They are described as good eaters
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs was told by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The instrumental form bhūcarī is unusual and may reflect textual transmission.
plain_english: O beloved, the teaching concerning the earth-moving, good-eating yoginīs was told by an earth-mover.
